• "This is a correct mistake" - In some cultures, "correct" is used to mean "incorrect" or "wrong." This phrase is used to convey that the mistake is, in fact, correct.
• "I'm a happy sad person" - In some cultures, "happy" is used to mean "sad" or "unhappy." This phrase is used to convey a sense of melancholy or sorrow.
• "I'm a simple complex person" - In some cultures, "simple" is used to mean "complex" or "complicated." This phrase is used to convey that you're a multifaceted individual.
